title: Best Video Repurposing Services (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire someone to turn long videos into shorts, clips and posts: what to include, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Video repurposing turns one long video, such as a podcast, webinar, interview or YouTube video, into many short clips for Shorts, Reels, TikTok and LinkedIn. It gets more value from content you already made. It goes wrong when clips are cut at random, captions are inaccurate, or every clip looks the same. This guide helps you get clips that stand on their own and bring viewers back to the full video.

faq.q: How many clips can one video produce?
faq.a: It depends on the content. A long, conversational video often contains several strong moments. Quality matters more than quantity; a few great clips beat many weak ones.
Either you, with time stamps, or the editor. If the editor chooses, ask them to explain why each moment was selected.
Yes. Most short videos are watched without sound. Captions should be accurate, easy to read and styled to match your brand.

faq.q: Can clips be used on every platform?
faq.a: Mostly, but each platform has its own length limits and style. Ask for versions suited to each one.

faq.q: Is AI used to find clips?
faq.a: Some editors use AI tools to find moments quickly. Human review is still needed to check context, captions and quality.
